services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: At Woodard Marine, we prioritize the safety and well-being of all our clients and staff. As part of our commitment to maintaining high standards of safety and responsibility, our company policy requires that every driver or renter of our boats, regardless of their birth year, must possess a valid boating license. This policy applies universally, including to those born before 1973. If you don't possess a boating license or safety certificate, rest assured, Woodard Marine has a solution in place for your convenience.
